stories.title: 'New season, new trim' - Haaland reveals buzzcut
stories.summary: Whether it be Zlatan Ibrahimovic, Gareth Bale or Erling Haaland, football has witnessed some iconic man buns over the years. However, Haaland has decided to begin the new Premier League season with a new - and very different - look. Haaland will be hoping his new look brings even more goals as he aims to get off the mark when Enzo Maresca's side face Bournemouth at 14:00 BST on Sunday. Before cutting his hair, Haaland joked around by showing off some images of his previous hairstyles during his career, and some questionable ideas of how his new hair should look. Looking nervous as the hairdresser cut the first piece, it didn't take long for Haaland to start smiling about his new appearance. There were mixed reactions when the 26‑year‑old made video calls to City team-mate Jack Grealish, Oasis' Noel Gallagher and former City manager Pep Guardiola. Gallagher said: "You look about 17 years old. It's good. Change is good." Grealish and Guardiola both said they "love" the change. "You look about 10 years old. That is hilarious.
